## 正文

## Definition

**gqa_ragged_prefill_causal_h8_kv1_d256** — Batched GQA prefill with ragged (variable-length) KV cache for Qwen3 Next 80B A3B at TP=2.

- Model: Qwen3 Next 80B A3B (16 q-heads, 2 kv-heads, head_dim=256)
- Config: TP=2 → 8 q-heads, 1 kv-head per device
- GQA ratio: 8 (power of 2, supported natively by FlashInfer)
- API: `BatchPrefillWithRaggedKVCacheWrapper`

## Coverage

`docs/model_coverage.mdx`: ❌ → ✅ for `gqa_ragged_prefill_causal_h8_kv1_d256`

Completes the ragged-prefill variant for the h8/kv1/d256 family alongside paged siblings #310 and #311.

## Reference Test Output

```
Output max abs diff: 7.812500e-03
Output mean abs diff: 2.460015e-04

Testing GQA Ragged Prefill h8/kv1/d256 (Qwen3 Next 80B A3B TP=2): batch=8, max_q=64, max_kv=128
Output max abs diff: 1.562500e-02
Output mean abs diff: 2.221223e-04
LSE max abs diff: 1.793146e-03
✓ PASSED

Summary: 3/3 tests passed
```

Note: atol=0.02 (vs 0.01 for d=128) — bfloat16 ULP at d=256 is 1/64 ≈ 0.0156.

## HF PR2

https://huggingface.co/datasets/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer-trace/discussions/239 (merged)

- 20 real SGLang workloads (Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B TP=2, batch sizes 1–64)
- 20 safetensors blobs (qo_indptr + kv_indptr)
- 20/20 traces PASSED (26x–750x speedup vs reference)
